room_rent.note: Options also available for General Ward, Twin Sharing, 1%/1.5%/2% of SI per day as alternatives

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals for all sum insured options

copayment.display: None (base); voluntary co-pay option available for discount
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. 20% co-pay on OPD reimbursement claims without pre-approval. 10% co-pay on International Cover (optional add-on).

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped (20% of SI max ₹1L/eye for SI ≤10L; actuals above); maternity sub-limits apply
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 20% of SI max ₹1L per eye for SI up to ₹10L; actuals for SI above ₹10L. Maternity: ₹50K–₹1L depending on SI. OPD doctor consult: ₹500 GP / ₹1,200 specialist per visit.

deductible.note: No standard deductible in base plan; deductible is defined in policy but not mandated by default

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents or renewals

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional reduction to 1 year or 2 years available. Portability credit applicable.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 32 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc. Reducible to 1 or 2 years via optional change. Not applicable for accidents.

maternity.note: Not covered for SI ₹3L & ₹4L. For SI ₹5L–₹10L: ₹50K; ₹15L–₹20L: ₹75K; above ₹20L: ₹1L. Max 2 deliveries/lifetime. Waiting period reduces by 1 year for long-term policy paid upfront. Surrogacy and ART complications also covered.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (25%/yr for SI ≤4L; 50%/yr for SI ≥5L)
cumulative_bonus.note: For SI ₹3L–₹4L: 25% per annum, max 100%. For SI ₹5L and above: 50% per annum, max 100%. CB reduces at same rate if claim made.

restoration.note: For SI ≥5L: unlimited reinstatement of full SI. For SI <5L: once per year. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 15-day gap from discharge (gap not required for different insured). Applicable for same illness too.

pre_hosp.note: Options available: 0, 15, 30, 60, 90, 180, 240 days (240 days for SI ≥5L only). Default/standard is 60 days as per Table of Benefits.

post_hosp.note: Options available: 0, 15, 30, 60, 90, 180, 240 days (240 days for SI ≥5L only). Default/standard is 90 days as per Table of Benefits.

day_care.display: All day-care (indicative list + any tech-advanced procedure)
day_care.note: Extensive indicative list provided; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technological advancement also covered

domiciliary.display: Covered (up to SI; must exceed 3 days)
domiciliary.note: Several conditions excluded from domiciliary cover including asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, vector-borne diseases, etc.

ayush.note: Requires minimum 24-hour hospitalisation in AYUSH hospital. Comfort treatments (steam bath, oil massage, resort packages) excluded.

organ_donor.note: Covers harvesting expenses for organ donor. Pre/post-hospitalisation of donor not covered. Reinstatement/CB not applicable for this cover.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to In-patient Hospitalisation SI. Airlift cover also available for SI ≥75L (optional, up to ₹10L–₹20L).

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy (haematological), intra-vitreal injections, etc.

consumables.note: Consumables cover (Annexure IV list) is inbuilt in Plan 1, up to In-patient Hospitalisation SI

global_cover.note: International Cover – Emergency Care Only available as optional add-on. 10% mandatory co-pay. Limited to 45 days/trip, 180 days/year. Pre/post-hosp and day care not covered internationally.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no look-back applied except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly instalment; 30 days for all other payment modes

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only, not on renewals or porting

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary excl: asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, vector-borne; external congenital anomalies; growth hormone therapy; non-emergency overseas treatment (base)

optional_riders.display: Loss of Income (weekly benefit), Major Illness & Accident Multiplier (indemnity), International Cover (emergency only)
